commands.name: artifacts clear
commands.description: Remove one flow's generated/ tree (--scenario requires --yes)

commands.name: artifacts generate
commands.description: Generate or regenerate one flow's artifacts (or every flow with --scenario)

commands.name: artifacts status
commands.description: Inspect the on-disk generated/ tree for one flow

commands.name: configure
commands.description: View or update CLI settings (api_base, token)

commands.name: flows codegen
commands.description: Emit codegen artifacts for a navigation flow (routes.generated.ts)

commands.name: flows explain
commands.description: Print the human-readable explain report for one flow

commands.name: flows list
commands.description: List every discovered flow

commands.name: flows new
commands.description: Scaffold a new flow under <feature-dir>/flow/

commands.name: flows reconcile
commands.description: Reconcile a navigation flow's spec against the scenario's ui/src tree

commands.name: flows show
commands.description: Print the typed flow.json projection consumed by the UI

commands.name: flows studio
commands.description: Print the Flow Studio descriptor (routes, affordances, containers, context toggles, invariant pass/fail) for one navigation flow

commands.name: flows validate
commands.description: Validate every flow against the embedded schema

commands.name: runs list
commands.description: List recent verification runs

commands.name: runs show
commands.description: Show one verification run (with counterexample on failure)

commands.name: scenarios list
commands.description: List every scenario discovered under the Vrooli root

commands.name: scenarios show
commands.description: Show one scenario with its discovered flows

commands.name: settings get
commands.description: Print the local principal's UI/CLI preferences

commands.name: settings set
commands.description: Update one or more preferences via <key>=<value> pairs

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check API health

commands.name: verify check
commands.description: Verify every flow: lint + freshness + Quint check

commands.name: verify run
commands.description: Regenerate artifacts (model.qnt, runtime, replay helper) for every flow

commands.name: verify show
commands.description: Show one verification's recorded run row
